'''Grrtok's H'muck''', translated as '''Hammer''', was a modified [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Grrtok]], and was used to transport his [[Grrtok's Band|mercenary band]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LE" />
